questions.label: Where will you build?
questions.hint: Town or area is enough. Location is recorded for review; it does not change the demo rates.

questions.label: Plot width (metres)
questions.hint: Enter the full boundary width in metres, not the desired house width. Decimals are allowed.

questions.label: Plot length (metres)
questions.hint: Enter the full plot length in metres. The demo fit check allows 1 m on each boundary.

questions.label: What shape is the plot?
questions.hint: The generator currently supports rectangular plots. Other shapes can be saved for further review.

questions.label: Is the land flat or sloped?
questions.hint: Sloped sites need further review. Unknown terrain is kept explicit and a generated concept assumes a flat site.

questions.label: Which edge has road access?
questions.hint: The road-facing edge helps orient the plot-fit check. Choose Unknown if you are unsure.

questions.label: Construction budget (ZAR)
questions.hint: Enter the amount available for construction in Rand, excluding the price of buying the land.

questions.label: How much space would you like in each room?
questions.hint: Room sizes are separate from finish quality. Balanced sizes are used if you leave this optional choice blank.

questions.label: Preferred finishes
questions.hint: This sets the illustrative rate per square metre. Materials shown in the house views remain indicative.

questions.label: What does your budget include?
questions.hint: Select all that apply. These expectations are recorded; the estimate does not separately price each selected item.

questions.label: How many people will live here?
questions.hint: Include adults and children who will usually live here. Room counts are entered separately below.

questions.label: Essential bedrooms
questions.hint: Count the bedrooms you need now, including any required guest bedroom.

questions.label: Essential bathrooms
questions.hint: Count all full bathrooms, including the main en-suite if you select it. Use at least two if you need an en-suite and a shared bathroom.

questions.label: Do you work from home?
questions.hint: A dedicated quiet office adds a room. A shared workspace is recorded without adding a room.

questions.label: What workspace do you need?
questions.hint: Only Dedicated quiet office adds an office to this layout. Shared workspace remains a request for review.

questions.label: How often do you host overnight guests?
questions.hint: This helps record household needs. Hosting frequency does not automatically add a guest bedroom.

questions.label: What accommodation would guests need?
questions.hint: Describe the sleeping arrangements you need. Include a guest bedroom in your bedroom count if essential.

questions.label: Kitchen arrangement
questions.hint: This changes whether the kitchen shares the living space or has its own room.

questions.label: Storage, laundry, pantry, and outdoor needs
questions.hint: For example: a pantry, extra cupboards, laundry or covered outdoor space. Saved for review, not automatically generated.

questions.label: Which additional spaces should the house include?
questions.hint: Optional. Selected spaces are generated and included in the footprint and demo estimate. An en-suite uses one of your bathroom spaces; it does not add to the count.

questions.label: Preferred architectural style
questions.hint: This changes the roof profile and exterior palette. Floor-plan arrangement and room sizes are selected separately.

questions.label: Preferred floor-plan arrangement
questions.hint: Best fit compares three reviewed dataset-derived families. A selected family is kept even if it exceeds the plot or budget, with conflicts shown.

questions.label: Bedroom privacy
questions.hint: Recorded for review. The current layout always separates private rooms from the front living area.

questions.label: Accessibility needs
questions.hint: These needs are saved for professional review. The prototype does not verify accessible clearances or step-free construction.

questions.label: Describe the access requirements
questions.hint: Describe the movement, doorway or access needs that should be checked during further design.

questions.label: Other essential features
questions.hint: List features that must not be overlooked. These are saved for review and are not automatically added.

questions.label: Which features could change to meet the budget?
questions.hint: Describe possible compromises. The generator will not silently remove rooms or features to meet the budget.

questions.label: Future extensions or household changes
questions.hint: For example: another bedroom later or a changing household. Extensions are recorded for review, not generated.
